sloka: शत्रुघ्नश्चापि रामस्य ववन्दे चरणौ रुदन्।तावुभौ स समालिङ्ग्य रामश्चाश्रूण्यवर्त्तयत् ॥ २.९९.४०॥
transliteration: śatrughnaścāpi rāmasya vavande caraṇau rudan।tāvubhau sa samāliṅgya rāmaścāśrūṇyavarttayat ॥ 2.99.40॥

translations.english: Satrughna also prostrated himself at the feet of tearful Rama who embraced both of them.
